description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose a Special Commodity Levy on rice in husk etc., valid for a period of 04 months commencing from 22.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy on rice products under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies tax rates and rescinds a previous order, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The content fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks for commodity taxation.
